author: isidore

lemma.la: super cor nostrum tenebrosum et fluidum, quasi super aquas
lemma.en: over our dark and fluid heart, as over waters

original.text: Et spiritus Dei ferebatur super aquas. Spiritus autem Dei super cor nostrum tenebrosum et fluidum, quasi super aquas, jam 262 superferebatur; in quo subsistentes requiesceremus, cujusque vivificaremur flatu, et cujus unda ablueremur.

english.text: 'And the Spirit of God was borne over the waters.' The Spirit of God was already being borne over our dark and fluid heart, as over waters: that standing in him we might find rest, be quickened by his breath, and be washed in his wave.

notes: Isidore does not answer the physical question at all; the waters are the heart. The allegorical reading the Glossa will carry in its margin.
